_note: Point systems registry. Each entry represents one organization's internal merit/currency system. Loaded as DEVOUR.cfg.points. Add new entries to 'systems' — they will auto-appear as cards in the Points tab.

systems.name: Academy Points System
systems.description: LMCA's internal merit currency. Required for dungeon access, equipment, training, and medical care. Designed to look like a merit system — functions as a stratification machine. AP cannot be freely exchanged into credits externally.
systems.ideology: Steel is made in fire. So are we.
systems.system_notes: The AP system's design ensures Apex Track students accumulate points faster by default — they have access to higher-yield dungeons from day one. Dormant students earn almost no AP from standard paths. The gap widens every month. A graduating Dormant who scraped together 500 AP has spent six years earning what an Apex student earns in one. The academy is aware of this. It considers it correct.
